title: Which Magic Academy House Are You?
description: The Sorting Ceremony awaits! Answer honestly and discover which of the four great houses would claim you.

answers.text: Volunteer for something before you even know the rules
Find the one person sitting alone and join them
Explore the whole building and read every posted notice
Figure out who's in charge and make a good impression

questions.text: You inherit a mysterious map. First move:

answers.text: Follow it immediately. Tonight.
Show your best friend — adventures are better shared
Authenticate it first. Maps can lie.
Tell no one until you know what it leads to
Leap first, look later
No one gets left behind
Question everything
Where there's a will, there's a way

results.description: Bold hearts and first steps. Emberharts run toward the challenge while others are still weighing it, and their courage gives everyone around them permission to be brave too.
Where there's a will, there's a Foxglen. Ambitious, resourceful, and always three moves ahead, they turn big dreams into finished plans — and make it look effortless.
Minds that never stop asking why. Larkspires collect knowledge like treasure and see puzzles where others see problems. If there's an answer, they'll find it — probably in a footnote.
The heart of the academy. Willowmeres remember birthdays, defend their friends, and turn groups of strangers into families. Loyalty isn't a rule for them — it's a reflex.
